description: Long work returns status:running and next_tool_call:get_job within a short response. Follow that SAME job until done; never repeat this tool to poll. FetchSandbox remediation: get a proposed fix for a specific bug in YOUR code. The 'fix' step after find_bugs. Ships the project to the FetchSandbox runtime, which authors a MINIMAL fix grounded in the known remediation for that failure class and returns a git diff — it does NOT modify your files. Review the diff, then call prove_fix with the diff and the STILL-BUGGY project BEFORE applying it. Apply the patch only after inspecting that result. The diff is a proposal, not a proof; quickrun and verify_behavior on reference handlers do not prove this change on your application. Runs for up to a few minutes.

bug.description: The specific bug to fix — ideally 'file:line — description', taken from a find_bugs finding.

fix_pattern.description: OPTIONAL. The known remediation pattern for this failure class, if you have it (e.g. from guide's matched_bug_pattern). Improves fix quality; the proof still certifies.

path.description: OPTIONAL. Absolute path to the project, as it is. Defaults to the current working directory. Do NOT copy the project first: fix_bug returns a diff and never writes to your tree.

spec.description: OPTIONAL. Grounding hint for the integration (e.g. 'stripe').

timeout_s.description: OPTIONAL. Fix budget in seconds (default 300, max 600).

name: fix_bug
